classification: prototype static authored-frame/current-pose stock glTF in Three r184; not shipped Blendlink behavior
limitations: Uses the exported camera node with its default/rest transform and no animation playback.
Enables Three AgX and shadows but does not recreate Blender compositor, depth of field, ambient occlusion, or world nodes.
Uses SwiftShader when system Chrome is available; it is not physical-GPU performance evidence.
